ja: あなたがもっと早く誘ってたら、彼女もパーティーに来られたのに。
en: If you had invited her sooner, she could have come to the party.
alternatives: If you'd asked her earlier, she could have made it to the party.
She could have come to the party if you had invited her earlier.
point: 過去の仮定は had invited と could have come

ja: 今週末ひまだったら君をキャンプに誘うんだけど、残念ながら仕事なんだ。
en: If I were free this weekend, I'd invite you camping, but unfortunately I have to work.
alternatives: If I had this weekend off, I'd ask you to go camping, but sadly I have to work.
I'd invite you camping if I were free this weekend, but unfortunately I've got work.
point: 現在の事実に反する仮定は If I were と過去形

ja: 来週末みんなでバーベキューをするんだけど、何か飲み物を持ってきてもらえる？
en: We're having a barbecue next weekend. Could you bring something to drink?
alternatives: We're going to have a barbecue next weekend. Can you bring something to drink?
We're having a barbecue next weekend, so could you bring some drinks?
point: 「飲み物」は something to drink と不定詞で後ろから説明

ja: 昨日、同僚にランチに誘われたけど、断ったんだ。
en: A coworker invited me to lunch yesterday, but I said no.
alternatives: A coworker invited me to lunch yesterday, but I declined.
My coworker asked me to lunch yesterday, but I said no.
point: 「誘われた」は coworker を主語に invited me で言える

ja: パーティーは何時に始まるの？
en: What time does the party start?
alternatives: When does the party start?
What time is the party?
point: 三人称単数の疑問文は does を使い start は原形

ja: 土曜の試合が終わったら、みんなでご飯を食べに行こうよ。
en: Let's all go get something to eat when the game ends on Saturday.
alternatives: When the game's over on Saturday, let's all go out to eat.
Let's all grab something to eat after Saturday's game finishes.
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形 ends

ja: 金曜の仕事のあと、私たちと一緒に夕食でもどうかなと思ってたんですが。
en: I was wondering if you'd like to grab dinner with us after work on Friday.
alternatives: I was wondering if you'd like to join us for dinner after work on Friday.
I was wondering whether you'd want to have dinner with us after work on Friday.
point: 過去進行形 I was wondering if で控えめに誘う

ja: チームのみんなに、金曜の食事会に来られるかどうか聞いてもらえますか？
en: Could you ask everyone on the team whether they can make it to Friday's dinner?
alternatives: Could you ask the team if they can come to the dinner on Friday?
Would you mind asking everyone on the team whether they can join us for dinner on Friday?
point: 間接疑問は whether they can の平叙文の語順

ja: 金曜の夜に花火大会があるんだけど、一緒に行かない？
en: There's a fireworks show Friday night. Want to go together?
alternatives: There's a fireworks festival on Friday night. Do you want to go together?
There's a fireworks display Friday night. Do you want to come with me?
point: 「〜がある」は There's で始め、誘いは Want to 〜? で軽く

ja: あのとき誘いを断ってなかったら、今ごろ私もみんなとキャンプ場にいたんだろうな。
en: If I hadn't turned down the invitation, I'd be at the campsite with everyone right now.
alternatives: If I hadn't said no to the invitation, I'd be at the campsite with everyone now.
If I'd accepted the invitation, I'd be at the campsite with everyone right now.
point: 過去の条件は had 過去分詞、今の結果は would be

ja: たとえ少し遅れても、ぜひ今夜のパーティーには来てね。
en: Even if you're a little late, please come to the party tonight.
alternatives: Even if you're running a bit late, do come to the party tonight.
Please come to the party tonight, even if you're a little late.
point: 「たとえ〜でも」は even if、中身は現在形

ja: 今夜のカラオケ、一緒に行けたらいいんだけど、明日の朝早い便に乗るんだ。
en: I wish I could join you for karaoke tonight, but I have an early flight tomorrow.
alternatives: I wish I could come to karaoke with you tonight, but I have an early flight tomorrow.
I wish I could go to karaoke with you guys tonight, but I've got an early flight tomorrow.
point: 今の叶わない願いは I wish I can ではなく I could

ja: ずっと君をキャンプに誘おうと思ってたんだけど、来月空いてる？
en: I've been meaning to invite you to go camping. Are you free next month?
alternatives: I've been wanting to ask you to go camping. Are you free next month?
I've been meaning to ask you to come camping. Are you free next month?
point: 「ずっと〜しようと思ってた」は I've been meaning to

ja: 今夜、一緒に夕食に行こうよ。
en: Let's go out for dinner tonight.
alternatives: Let's have dinner together tonight.
Let's go get dinner tonight.
point: 誘いは Let's＋動詞の原形で始める

ja: ごめん、土曜日は忙しいんだ。
en: Sorry, I'm busy on Saturday.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm busy this Saturday.
Sorry, I'm not free on Saturday.
point: busy は形容詞なので be 動詞が必要

ja: 佐藤さん一家が今週末バーベキューを計画してるんだけど、あなたも来る？
en: The Satos are planning a barbecue this weekend. Do you want to come?
alternatives: The Satos are having a barbecue this weekend. Want to come?
The Satos are planning a barbecue this weekend. Are you coming too?
point: 計画中のことは進行形 are planning、気軽な誘いは Do you want to come?

ja: 来週の土曜日のほうが、私たちには都合がいいです。
en: Next Saturday is better for us.
alternatives: Next Saturday works better for us.
Next Saturday would be better for us.
point: 日付を主語にして is better for us。We are better にしない

ja: 行きたいんだけど、今週の土曜は上司に出勤させられるから、今回はパスするね。
en: I'd love to come, but my boss is making me work this Saturday, so I'll have to pass this time.
alternatives: I'd really like to go, but my boss is making me work this Saturday, so I'll have to sit this one out.
I'd love to join you, but my boss is having me work this Saturday, so I'll pass this time.
point: make me work の work は原形で、to は付けない

ja: 今夜のパーティー、もう誘われた？
en: Have you been invited to tonight's party yet?
alternatives: Has anyone invited you to tonight's party yet?
Have you gotten an invitation to tonight's party yet?
point: 「もう〜された？」は Have you been + 過去分詞 + yet

ja: 彼女の誕生日パーティーに、ケーキを一つ持っていくね。
en: I'll bring a cake to her birthday party.
alternatives: I'm going to bring a cake to her birthday party.
I'll take a cake to her birthday party.
point: 丸ごとのケーキは数えられるので a cake

ja: 妹が、今週末のバーベキューには行くけど、たぶん少し遅れるって言ってたよ。
en: My sister said she'd come to the barbecue this weekend, but that she'd probably be a little late.
alternatives: My sister told me she'd come to the barbecue this weekend but would probably be a little late.
My sister said she was coming to this weekend's barbecue but would probably be a bit late.
point: 「言ってた」に合わせて will ではなく would にする

ja: 彼女、コンサートのあとにみんなで新しいラーメン屋に行こうって提案してたよ。
en: She suggested going to the new ramen place together after the concert.
alternatives: She suggested that we all go to the new ramen place after the concert.
She suggested we all go to the new ramen shop after the concert.
point: suggest の後は to 不定詞ではなく -ing か that 節

ja: 彼女が本当に知りたいのは、君が土曜のパーティーに来られるかどうかだよ。
en: What she really wants to know is whether you can come to the party on Saturday.
alternatives: What she really wants to know is if you can make it to the party on Saturday.
What she actually wants to know is whether you can come to Saturday's party.
point: 「〜なのは」は What で始め、かどうかは whether 節

ja: 急な出張が入って、送別会の誘いを断らなきゃいけなかったんだ。
en: I had to turn down the farewell party invitation because of a sudden business trip.
alternatives: I had to decline the invitation to the farewell party because of a sudden business trip.
Because of a sudden business trip, I had to say no to the farewell party invitation.
point: 「誘いを断る」は turn down。長い目的語は down の後ろに置く

ja: 彼女、先週のランチの誘いは断ったけど、今週末の映画にはもう OK してくれたよ。
en: She turned down lunch last week, but she's already said yes to a movie this weekend.
alternatives: She said no to lunch last week, but she's already agreed to see a movie this weekend.
She declined lunch last week, but she's already said yes to a movie this weekend.
point: 先週は過去形、「もう OK した」は現在完了で使い分ける
